module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Differing Leverage Tiers in Same MAM Group
precondition: Acc 1 has 1:500 leverage (Professional); Acc 2 has 1:30 leverage (ESMA Retail).
steps: 1. Master opens identical 1.00 lot EURUSD on both.
expected_result: Acc 1 uses $200 margin (1:500); Acc 2 uses $3,333 margin (1:30); both accounts maintain safe isolated margin levels.
actual_result: Margin calculated per tier: 1:500 requires $216.00; 1:30 requires $3600.00. Sub-accounts maintain isolated margin.
